data.content_ref: inline:The neighbourhood's admissible enrichments (SRC_005, SRC_006, SRC_007, SRC_011, SRC_012) and the four diagnostic foundations (SRC_002, SRC_003, SRC_004, SRC_008) integrate into one commutative pipeline: enrich edges (pre-fixpoint) → compute grounded labeling → derive annotations (post-fixpoint). The covering principle is that the fixpoint is a functor F from enriched graphs to labelings, and every diagnostic is a natural transformation η: F ⇒ D. This makes the whole system compositional: any two admissible enrichments compose, and any two diagnostics compose, without disturbing the skeptical core. REFUTED IF the pipeline is not functorial — i.e., if applying two enrichments sequentially gives a different result than applying their composition — or if a diagnostic is not natural under graph homomorphisms that preserve attack structure.
